from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Financial data extracted from a single company's 2025 Q1 report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock code of the company, if provided")
    monetary_funds: float | None = Field(description="Monetary funds ending balance (Numerator)")
    cash_paid_to_employees: float | None = Field(description="Cash paid to employees and for employees (Denominator part)")
    cash_paid_for_goods_services: float | None = Field(description="Cash paid for goods and services (Denominator part)")
    financial_expenses: float | None = Field(description="Financial expenses (Denominator part)")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2025-Q1'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_data: list[CompanyFinancialData]
